authorization_rule: No paid model request may start unless a signed review artifact tied to the exact reviewed commit and policy hash records GO, every required gate passes, and unresolved assumptions is empty.
golden_trace_cases: failed IPython turn followed by retry
concurrent children completing in either order
prohibited_substitutes: source-text or AST inspection without execution
config-object tests without the production parse path
mocking the pipeline component under review
scientific-design review standing in for runtime review
hash verification standing in for behavioral validation
future_runner_requirement: Every new paid runner must verify the signed GO artifact before ADDRESS_STARTED and before any model request.
